verdict.rationale: Runloop's own homepage claims '10GB image startup time in <2s', and its blueprint docs describe template images for optimized Devbox startup, so the product does assert few-second cold starts. That figure is a single marketing line rather than in-depth documentation, and nothing hands-on or independent corroborates it. missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of cold-start latency (conditions, percentiles, blueprint vs snapshot vs base image), independent or hands-on benchmarks confirming sub-second-to-few-second starts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start sandboxes with documented sub-second-to-few-second cold starts

citations.quote: Template images for optimized Devbox startup
